ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Arbitrary Command Execution Via FTP.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "ftp.exe" script with the "-s" or "/s" flag and any child processes ran by "ftp.exe".

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ftp\\\.exe$") OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\ftp\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ftp\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-s\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/s\\:.*")))
